statement: The Panel-2 same-token boundary recurrence S_pair_6 remains above a null conditioned on each genome's recovered tokens and exact boundary-token counts within fixed-GC-count × wildcard-separation strata.
support_condition: Observed above conditioned-null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo p<=0.05; strong support p<=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above conditioned-null mean but p>0.05.
contamination_boundary: Frozen after the unconditioned Panel-2 result but before any composition-conditioned null was calculated.
